note: Works chosen for the lobe library: paintings where broad ink (a splash, a wash, a blot) is answered by lines. Fine-line landscapes, gongbi and narrative paintings are left out. All are CC0 in the Cleveland Museum of Art's Open Access collection; the build checks each one's licence again.
